title: Barter & Trade in Emergencies
description: Ranks trade goods in three demand tiers and covers junk silver vs. gold, trading skills, valuing and negotiating fair trades, and keeping records. Includes trade security and red flags, building a trade network, what not to trade, and a barter preparedness checklist.
shortDescription: Tiered trade goods, junk silver, skills as currency, and safe trading
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
